subject: reasoning
question: A government bans single-use plastic, claiming it will reduce ocean pollution. Which of the following, if true, best supports this decision?

options.text: Most plastic waste in oceans comes from fishing nets and industrial waste.
Citizens are unaware of recycling methods.
A majority of coastal waste is composed of single-use plastic items.
Plastic alternatives are more expensive and less durable.

solution:
Given: A government bans single-use plastic, claiming it will reduce ocean pollution.

Let's check all the options:

(1) Most plastic waste in oceans comes from fishing nets and industrial waste ⇒ **It does not support the decision ( **This weakens the decision as it shifts blame away from single-use plastic.)

(2) Citizens are unaware of recycling methods ⇒**It does not support the decision. ( ** This is irrelevant to the ban on single-use plastic )

**(3) A majority of coastal waste is composed of single-use plastic items ⇒** **It best supports the decision. ( ** Directly proves that banning single-use plastic will reduce ocean pollution. )

(4) Plastic alternatives are more expensive and less durable ⇒ **It does not support the decision. ( ** This weakens the decision as it shows the ban may not be practical.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
